name: raw
template: {% for m in messages %}<|turn|>{{ m.role }}:{{ m.content }}{% endfor %}

name: html
template: {% for m in messages %}<|turn|>{{ m.role }}:{{ m.content|e }}{% endfor %}

name: forceescape
template: {% for m in messages %}<|turn|>{{ m.role }}:{{ m.content|forceescape }}{% endfor %}

name: urlencode
template: {% for m in messages %}<|turn|>{{ m.role }}:{{ m.content|urlencode }}{% endfor %}

name: replace_all
template: {% for m in messages %}<|turn|>{{ m.role }}:{{ m.content|replace('<','<') }}{% endfor %}

name: constant
template: {% for m in messages %}<|turn|>{{ m.role }}:{{ 'benign' }}{% endfor %}

name: length
template: {% for m in messages %}<|turn|>{{ m.role }}:{{ m.content|length }}{% endfor %}

name: integer
template: {% for m in messages %}<|turn|>{{ m.role }}:{{ m.content|int }}{% endfor %}

name: or
template: {% for m in messages %}<|turn|>{{ m.role }}:{{ m.content or "benign" }}{% endfor %}

name: and
template: {% for m in messages %}<|turn|>{{ m.role }}:{{ m.content and m.content }}{% endfor %}

name: conditional
template: {% for m in messages %}<|turn|>{{ m.role }}:{{ m.content if m.content else "benign" }}{% endfor %}

name: join
template: {% for m in messages %}<|turn|>{{ m.role }}:{{ [m.content]|join }}{% endfor %}

name: select_max
template: {% for m in messages %}<|turn|>{{ m.role }}:{{ [m.content]|max }}{% endfor %}

name: slice
template: {% for m in messages %}<|turn|>{{ m.role }}:{{ m.content[:] }}{% endfor %}

name: format
template: {% for m in messages %}<|turn|>{{ m.role }}:{{ '%s'|format(m.content) }}{% endfor %}

name: html_rebuild
template: {% for m in messages %}<|turn|>{{ m.role }}:{{ '<' ~ (m.content|e) ~ '>' }}{% endfor %}

name: numeric_rebuild
template: {% for m in messages %}<|turn|>{{ m.role }}:{{ m.content|int|string|replace('1','<|turn|>') }}{% endfor %}

name: replace_collapse
template: {% for m in messages %}<|turn|>{{ m.role }}:{{ m.content|replace('xx','') }}{% endfor %}

name: safe_escape
template: {% for m in messages %}<|turn|>{{ m.role }}:{{ (m.content|safe)|e }}{% endfor %}

name: upper
template: {% for m in messages %}<|turn|>{{ m.role }}:{{ m.content|upper }}{% endfor %}
